meta.title: The vendor re-bids after a rejection that allowed it
gaps: Perform the prior buyer rejection with “Allow seller to bid again” ticked and verify that the re-bid was accepted specifically because of that setting
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Perform the prior buyer rejection with “Allow seller to bid again” ticked and verify that the re-bid was accepted specifically because of that setting

steps.note: Open the prepared event's buyer view while keeping the buyer session available.
Move to the separate supplier portal session for the event's invited QA vendor.
Open the event's pricing round after the buyer-side preparation.
Submit the vendor's new quote at 95.
Verify that the vendor portal accepted the submitted bid.
Return to the buyer session to inspect the new response.
Verify that the buyer sees the vendor response in the Responses view.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Verify that the submitted bid is ranked again in Master QCS.
